evidence_quotes.quote: Physics and Chemistry of the Earth 127 (2022) 103155
Water policy and resilience of potable water infrastructure to climate risks in rural Malawi
Using Zomba rural in Southern Malawi as a case study, this study was therefore aimed at addressing this gap by assessing the effectiveness of local water policy responses to extreme weather events
